changelog:
pangolinfo-ai-serp 4.0.0 – Core authentication update & strict clientSource enforcement

- Now requires every MCP tool call to include the top-level argument `"clientSource":"skill"` (not optional).
- Updated API key handling: keys are now JWT strings (e.g., `eyJhbGci...`), not `pgl_`-prefix; all documentation and instructions updated accordingly.
- Clarified setup and authentication flow—removed all references to the obsolete `pgl_` key prefix.
- Removed obsolete file: `skill-card.md`.
- No functional change to skill capabilities or tool mappings; breaking changes are only in client/tool integration and setup requirements.
